references.text: Jesus warns the disciples that they will be persecuted, which is similar to the warning in Mark 13:9.
Luke gives a parallel warning about persecution of the disciples, resembling what is described in Mark 13:9.
Isaiah prophesied about persecution, which can be seen as a precursor to what Jesus warns about in Mark 13:9.
Jeremiah experiences persecution, which reflects the warning Jesus gives in Mark 13:9.
Paul warns Timothy that godly people will suffer persecution, corresponding with Jesus' warning in Mark 13:9.
